title: 理性理由传递了什么？角色专用问答中的消息干预研究
summary: 研究通过消息干预诊断发现，在推理者到验证者的角色专用QA流程中，忠实理由几乎不提升答案准确率，但被篡改的理由会显著改变支持判断（10-22%），显式检查提示下可达34-55%。人类审计显示模型会过度信任被篡改的理由。理由共享应被视为验证消息机制而非提升答案准确率的途径。
summary_en: A message-intervention study on role-specialized QA pipelines finds that faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly shift support judgments (10-22%, up to 34-55% with explicit checking prompts). Human audits reveal corruption-overtrust cases. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely a route to higher answer accuracy.
